NEW: House Democrats are facing a wave of calls urging them to reject Hakeem Jeffries as speaker despite the party’s landslide election victory. 
Some lawmakers report receiving more than 500 calls, while a petition opposing Jeffries has gathered nearly 900,000 signatures. 
One Democrat said, “It's our No. 1 issue, and it's not close,” while another reported that “lots of people are saying make Jamie Raskin speaker.” 
Progressive activists oppose Jeffries over his pro-Israel ties and perceived lack of resistance to Trump.
However, Jeffries remains the overwhelming favorite, with one senior progressive putting the chances of his defeat at “0.0%.”
Source: Axios

Stephen Miller, Trump’s new White House chief of staff, plans to press ahead with his hard-line immigration agenda despite Republicans’ heavy midterm losses.
Miller is expected to push for stronger executive power and resist compromises with Democrats, who are preparing investigations into his policies. 
Source: NYT

Republicans’ crushing midterm defeat has raised doubts about JD Vance’s potential 2028 presidential bid. 
On election night, a longtime confidant texted Vance suggesting he consider sitting out the race. 
Some of his allies now believe no Republican can win the presidency in 2028, while Vance himself remains undecided about running.
Source: WSJ
